STEP 1 - Scene: A plated, restaurant-style dinner with breaded or fried tofu-like pieces, greens, a grain, and vegetable garnishes.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white square-ish dinner plate, about 26 cm across. Area is about 530 cm². No food sits on other plates in the frame.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Breaded, fried tofu or fish-like pieces
- Leafy greens (arugula or chard), some sautéed
- Cooked grain (quinoa or farro) scattered among the greens
- Carrot slice
- Corn round

STEP 4 - Area (share of the 530 cm² plate):
- Breaded tofu/fish pieces: ~15%
- Leafy greens: ~8%
- Grain: ~3%
- Carrot: ~1%
- Corn: ~1.5%
- Total covered: ~28%, which is consistent with a sparse plating.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Tofu: 80 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 160 ml
- Greens: 42 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 85 ml
- Grain: 16 cm² × 0.8 cm ≈ 13 ml
- Carrot: 5 cm² × 1 cm ≈ 5 ml
- Corn: 8 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 16 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Tofu: 160 ml × 0.9 ≈ 144 g
- Greens: 85 ml × 0.15 ≈ 13 g
- Grain: 13 ml × 0.8 ≈ 10 g
- Carrot: 5 ml × 0.6 ≈ 3 g
- Corn: 16 ml × 0.6 ≈ 10 g
- Total ≈ 180 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Breaded fried tofu: 144 g × 220 kcal/100 g ≈ 317 kcal
- Greens: 13 g × 25 kcal/100 g ≈ 3 kcal
- Grain: 10 g × 120 kcal/100 g ≈ 12 kcal
- Carrot: 3 g × 40 kcal/100 g ≈ 1 kcal
- Corn: 10 g × 90 kcal/100 g ≈ 9 kcal
- Total ≈ 362 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 180 g and about 360 kcal fits a modest fine-dining main with a light side. The breading and any oil in the frying are the main uncertainty, so the energy figure could be off by 20–30%.
